name: Oshkosh
outlook:
What Oshkosh says to expect

  • Full year 2026: earnings per share and net salesThe Company now expects its 2026 diluted earnings per share to be between $8.00 and $9.00 and its adjusted 1 earnings per share to be between $8.50 and $9.50, down between $1.50 and $2.50 from its most recent guidance. The Company now expects net sales to be approximately $11.0 billion in 2026, down $0.2 billion from its previous guidance.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
